title: Place: Leicester Abbey
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a place name.

Leicester Abbey

anchor.prefix: That was a long time ago then out on the playgrounds in the evening light, creeping from point to point on the fringe of his line, a heavy bird flying low through the grey light.
anchor.suffix:
lit up. Wolsey died there. The abbots buried him themselves.

 It was not Wells’s face, it was the prefect’s. He was not foxing. No, no: he was sick really. He was not foxing. And
